title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
abstract: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising.Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据精确 arXiv 版本 2611.23845v1 的 10 页全文及关键页面核验；实验数字均为作者报告，未独立复现。
analysis.ideaZh: 作者报告：ReflectScene 在scene-layout diffusion内闭环选对象位置/朝向修正，MLLM生成候选，轻量predictor替代候选评分，每50步把接受动作写入persistent targets并投影clean estimate。作者三类房间的FID与prompt-semantic指标改善，但碰撞PIoU未全面优于baseline，52.4倍加速仅评分环节且排除上游scene理解，适合关注局部修正如何持续进入去噪。
analysis.motivationZh: 仅固定文本条件的场景diffusion不能据生成中的语义错误做对象级修正，后处理又可能破坏原布局。
analysis.methodZh: near-neighbor/long-range scene features经adapter连接frozenMLLM，多视角object visual alignment只用于训练。MLLM提出translation/yaw actions，先filter几何无效候选，再用distilled P/F/S scores与modification cost选动作。decision encoder提供transient condition，buffer汇总纠正为persistent attribute state，每步在clean estimate上soft project，使accepted targets跨后续denoising保持。
methodFlow: frozenMLLM生成object translation/yaw候选并做geometry filter
distilled reward predictor按prompt/function/semantic排序并惩罚大改动
将targets投影clean estimate再DDPM采样，并训练target/preservation loss
analysis.experimentsZh: 3D-FRONT4110/1068/576 splits，3D-FUTURE33 furniture classes；test每房型192 scenes与1500prompts。三类房间同assets/render protocols对DiffuScene/InstructScene/M3DLayout；candidate scorer接受集40newscenes、93tasks、1488questions。 作者报告Bedroom/Dining/Living FID108.70/117.38/110.62，对M3DLayout115.63/138.10/122.78；PSA82.5/74.7/78.1（Table 1, p. 7）。 作者报告progressive removals从full FID69.37/PSA78.4至移除三组件80.22/66.7（Table 2, p. 8）。 作者报告reward student task-preference98.98%、coverage100%，candidate-eval9.66ms；teacher99.24%、coverage99.90%、506.24ms（Table 3, p. 8）。 同split/render重训三个scene baselines；未对比同MLLM预算的强post-hoc repair，也没有全程latency、human functionality study或room外generalization。 reward、understanding、DCD是逐步累计移除，不是各自独立one-factor对照；有adapter-only/MLLM和model-scale comparison，但不充分隔离persistentprojection与transientcondition。
analysis.insightZh: 相比post-hoc scene repair，把有限属性对象action、暂态condition与持久clean-estimate projection纳入同一去噪轨迹是实质方法；未证明区域外严格不变，也不具备任意object-edit或物理仿真能力。
analysis.evidenceZh: candidate ranking被distill，但candidate generation与scene understanding仍依赖MLLM（Sec. 3.1–3.2, Eqs. 11–18, pp. 4–6）。可降低重复打分cost，不能声称整个闭环已移除MLLM。 修正靠transient decision加persistent mask/target state重复投影，而非最后一次平移对象（Sec. 3.2–3.3, Eqs. 15–24, pp. 5–6; Fig. 2, p. 4）。每50step buffer顺序执行，later action可覆盖同属性；preserve loss仅学习非target保留。 作者报告：三房间FID/PSA改善，但PIoU与KID未全部胜出（Table 1, p. 7）。living PIoU本方法.44，M3DLayout.31；living KID9.63对M3D9.48。 作者报告：reward scorer速度收益严格限cached features与五候选评估（Table 3, p. 8）。506.24→9.66ms，exclude upstream U计算，不能换算全程生成52.4倍加速。
analysis.caveatZh: 无单独limitations章节，补充材料被引用但该10页PDF未包含；很多训练/evaluation细节需后续公开。 操作仅horizontal translation/yaw，不改asset数量类别形状或尺寸，physical consistency不能视为受动力学验证。 PIoU未全面改善，表示几何可行与prompt/functionality仍有tradeoff；reward teacher agreement不是human accuracy。 本轮未确认可公开使用的作者实现。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接创建受语义/功能约束的3D室内layout，object-level correction与去噪trajectory耦合可迁移到编辑约束生成；使用MLLM只是手段，主归3DGeneration。
